First, we express our triple integral as a repeated integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∭}_{R}\frac{{3}^{y-1}\operatorname{sin}⁡x}{z-4}\,\text{d}V & ={\int }_{5}^{7}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{\pi /3}^{\pi /2}\frac{{3}^{y-1}\operatorname{sin}⁡x}{z-4}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\end{aligned}
$$

Since the domain of integration $R=[\frac{\pi }{3},\frac{\pi }{2}]\times [0,1]\times [5,7]$ is a rectangular box and the integrand can be expressed as $f(x)\cdot g(y)\cdot h(z),$ we can rewrite our repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{5}^{7}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{\pi /3}^{\pi /2}\frac{{3}^{y-1}\operatorname{sin}⁡x}{z-4}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z & ={\int }_{5}^{7}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{\pi /3}^{\pi /2}\frac{{3}^{y-1}\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡x}{z-4}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z \\  & ={\int }_{\pi /3}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{1}{3}^{y-1}\,\text{d}y{\int }_{5}^{7}\frac{1}{z-4}\,\text{d}z\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating each integral separately, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\pi /3}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{1}{3}^{y-1}\,\text{d}y{\int }_{5}^{7}\frac{1}{z-4}\,\text{d}z & =[-\operatorname{cos}⁡x]_{\pi /3}^{\pi /2}\cdot {[\frac{{3}^{y-1}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3}]}_{0}^{1}\cdot [\operatorname{ln}⁡(z-4)]_{5}^{7} \\  & =(-0+\frac{1}{2})\cdot (\frac{1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3}-\frac{1}{3\operatorname{ln}⁡3})\cdot (\operatorname{ln}⁡3-0) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{2}{3\operatorname{ln}⁡3}\cdot \operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\  & =\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
